name: sudden-defence
description: Round-based team elimination FPS in the browser. Procedural everything, no art assets, no netcode.

scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run test:render && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:logic: npm run lint && npm run test:layering && npm run test:headless && npm run test:netsim && npm run test:cmdstream && npm run test:replay && npm run test:reach && npm run test:navsanity && npm run test:symmetry && npm run test:playtest && npm run test:hitbox && npm run test:vault && npm run test:botfight && npm run test:matchsim && npm run test:hud && npm run test:roundreset && npm run test:debris && npm run test:phasecue && npm run test:ballistics && npm run test:threat && npm run test:firerate && npm run test:aim && npm run test:perceive
scripts.test:render: npm run test:legibility && npm run test:legibility:clutter && npm run test:markings && npm run test:friendfoe && npm run test:pixelgate && npm run test:crossengine && npm run test:determinism
scripts.test:crossengine: for s in 0x5eed1234 1 424242 1519997492; do node tools/crossengine.mjs --gate --engines=chromium,firefox,webkit --ticks=3600 --seed=$s || exit 1; done
